title: From Seattle Snoqualmie Falls Half Day Trip with Scenic Views
blurb:
Explore the stunning Snoqualmie Falls and the Cascade Mountain range on this delightful day trip from Seattle. Witness the power of the 270-foot waterfall and enjoy multiple observation decks for breathtaking vistas. Choose to hike or catch a ride to the base of the falls, complete with insights about local flora and fauna. The tour includes a scenic drive through the charming town of Snoqualmie, and time for potential Twin Peaks filming location stops. Learn more about the Snoqualmie tribe from our Knowledgeable guides who will enrich your experience with captivating stories, making this tour a perfect outing for nature lovers and families alike.

- Duration: 3 hours, suitable for all ages
- Comfortable transportation in a sightseeing minibus
- Options to hike to the base of the falls or enjoy upper observation decks
- Visit Salish Lodge and explore local culture and history
